text.p: Intermedia Communications Inc said Thursday it made interconnection agreements with Bell Atlantic Corp and GTE Corp.
Intermedia said the pacts give it a "virtually uninterrupted footprint" to bring local telephone service into major cities of the eastern United States.

"These agreements with Bell Atlantic and GTE complete our interconnection coverage on the East Coast from Florida to New York, and beyond," said David Ruberg, Intermedia's chairman, president and chief executive.

Intermedia's Bell Atlantic agreement will entail putting 35 local and long distance switches into service by the end of 1999. The GTE agreement is an expansion of its previously signed deal, covering all of GTE's territories in Florida, California, North Carolina, and Texas.
It also allows Intermedia to resell and have access to unbundled network elements in GTE territories, the company said.
